texts.zh: 从[This.ContactCountry.GetName]信号中读取的信息让我们的[Owner.GetLinguists]及其兴奋。尽管这其中没有一个音节是我们能够识别的，但不可否认的是，声音本身是有韵律的，而且听起来莫名地令人感到舒缓。虽然我们无法确定，但[Owner.GetLinguists]坚信这是一首诗歌，对方是在友善地回应我们。
texts.en: The readings from the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] signals have caused our [Owner.GetLinguists] a great deal of excitement. While not a single syllable is intelligible, the sounds themselves are undeniably rhythmical, and indeed curiously soothing. Although we cannot be sure, our [Owner.GetLinguists] are convinced that it is a form of poetry. They propose we answer in kind.

label.en: Of course. Send back a battle chant!

texts.zh: 在我们播报了战歌数个小时后，来自[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的通讯中断了。他们把舰船远远地开到了有效攻击距离以外。可以认为他们应该是理解了我们信息的主旨，并且对此可一点都不感到高兴。
texts.en: Several hours after we broadcast the battle chant, transmissions from the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] ceased. Their ship has positioned itself well out of effective attack range. We can surmise that they understood the gist of our message, and were not gladdened by what they heard.

label.en: Unfortunate.

texts.zh: 就在我们发出信息的数分钟后，来自[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的信息发生了变化。内容依旧抑扬顿挫，但不再是和风细雨，而如同激起了惊涛骇浪。听起来像是一首战争的颂歌。他们并没有做出什么敌对的行为，而只是被我们的战歌所打动了而已。我们又发送了起初那首诗的几个不同版本，并且也快速地在整理[This.ContactCountry.GetName]战歌的大纲。
texts.en: Within minutes of our transmission, the signals from the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] changed. Still rhythmically flawless, they were no longer soothing, but rather upbeat, exciting. Much like a battle chant in fact. No hostile movements were made - they seem contented rather than provoked by our poetry. We have since sent several variations of the first chant, and in return are rapidly collecting a compendium of [This.ContactCountry.GetName] war poetry.

label.zh: 和这个物种真是相见恨晚。
label.en: A species after our own hearts.

texts.zh: 对方对我们诗歌热忱回应：他们发来了一串不间断的长时间通讯，我们可以迅速地构建[This.ContactCountry.GetName]行文字典。尽管我们还未能辨识这些单词的含义，但这些外星人好像对对应我们诗歌中的平仄清浊得心应手，这也便于我们的[Owner.GetLinguists]理解他们。
texts.en: The response to our poem appears to have been enthusiastic: the stream of broadcasts continues unabated, and we are developing a considerable library of [This.ContactCountry.GetName] compositions. Although we have yet to put meanings to the words, these aliens have proven remarkably adept at matching the pitch and tone of our poems, something which is sure to help our [Owner.GetLinguists] interpret them.

label.en: How pleasant of them.

texts.zh: 在几分钟的沉默后，[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的通讯恢复了。尽管还不能理解，但他们的态度发生了明显的转变：我们的[Owner.GetLinguists]称听到了俏皮而扭捏的旋律。虽然有点难以置信，似乎他们在与我们调情。
texts.en: After several long minutes of silence, the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] transmissions resumed. Although still incomprehensible, they were markedly different: a melody described by our [Owner.GetLinguists] as playful, almost bashful. Startlingly, it appears that they are flirting with us!

label.en: How embarrassing.
A reasonable response.

texts.zh: 焦急等待的过程分秒如年，[This.ContactCountry.GetName]依旧没有回应。尽管他们不太可能理解我们诗歌的具体含义，但他们好像对里面的情感表达吓住了，开始转用一种更谨慎的态度与我们接触。
texts.en: Minutes turned into hours, and still there was no response from the [This.ContactCountry.GetName]. Though they couldn't possibly have understood the exact meaning of our poetry, it seems they were taken aback by the emotions expressed in it, and are now approaching us in a far more guarded manner.

label.en: Unfortunate.

texts.zh: [This.ContactCountry.GetName]以相似的方式回应了：抑扬顿挫的诗歌变成了随机的噪音，模仿着我们的嗓音。很遗憾，我们的[Owner.GetLinguists]表示，对这些声音的解码“完全没有用”，因为现在的这些信号根本没有任何规律可言。
texts.en: The [This.ContactCountry.GetName] are responding in kind: rhythmical chants have turned to random noise, mimicking our own incoherent sounds. Despairingly, our [Owner.GetLinguists] describe our efforts to decode these sounds as "completely useless", owing to the fact that it is now impossible to detect any sort of pattern.

label.en: This will set us back.

texts.zh: 好像[This.ContactCountry.GetName]听完我们的战歌以后生气了。他们的几乎瞬间回以暴力。他们的武器开始开火，我们的舰船很幸运地全身而退。看来一场大战是不可避免了。
texts.en: It appears the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] took offense to our battle chant. Their response was instantaneous - and violent. They began firing, and our vessel was fortunate to escape unharmed. It seems we have a fight on our hands!
